title: In un coupè?
subtitle: Back in the garret, Rodolfo and Marcello pretend to work and to have got over Musetta and Mimì, each seeing through the other, La bohème, Act 4

passages.label: Marcello: In un coupè?; Rodolfo saw Musetta with horses and livery: e il cuor? (Allegro vivo, Quadro quarto)
«Non batte o non lo sento» (Lo stesso movimento, 9/8); Ci ho gusto davver!; Loiola va!; Non batte? Bene! ((1))
Io pur vidi... Mimì. L'hai vista? Oh guarda!
Era in carrozza vestita come una regina (Lo stesso movimento, 2/4); Evviva! Ne son contento; Bugiardo, si strugge d'amor; Lavoriam
(2): Che penna infame! Che infame pennello!; Sostenuto, Andantino: Marcello takes out a silk ribbon and kisses it

licences.source: G. Ricordi & C. vocal score of La bohème, pages 223-227 (from the start of the Quadro quarto, top of page 223, to the double bar at the end of page 227, 85 bars)
licences.author: Carlo Carignani (1857–1919), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each transcribed independently, disagreements settled on the page by a separate judge, then checked against the print and corrected. Rodolfo's part is printed in the treble clef and written here at sounding pitch. The piano's right hand in bars 29-30, printed in 3/4 inside the 9/8 bars, is written as duplets. Tempo from the printed metronome mark Allegro vivo ♩. = 108 (bar 1); the two “lo stesso movimento” changes (bar 27, 9/8; bar 55, 2/4) keep the quaver, as the recordings show; the a piacere bars, the Sostenuto (bar 76) and the Andantino (bar 77) carry no number and are values chosen as stated in the piece's notes.
